DisplayName.value: UL - Restore tvCRT_PlayerOff (for FNS Exham Priory)

Description.value: Undead Legacy removes block tvCRT_PlayerOff; the FNS POI vb_FNS_Exham_Priory uses it and fails to load. Re-adds it as a plain UL CRT TV (not craftable). Needed on host AND clients. Do not remove once the POI has generated.
